body: The community repository for the Draw Things app.
plain_description: Run professional AI image generation on your own infrastructure — Apple devices, Linux GPU servers, or both. No cloud dependency, no per-image fees, full control over your data and models. Also supports LoRA fine-tuning and model serving for production workflows.
technical_description: Draw Things Community is the open-source repository containing the core inference, training, and serving components of the Draw Things application. It provides re-implementations of diffusion model architectures and samplers, a gRPC server (gRPCServerCLI) for headless GPU-accelerated inference on Linux and macOS, and a CLI tool for local generation and LoRA fine-tuning. The server supports NVIDIA CUDA acceleration on Linux via Docker or bare-metal deployment, while the macOS toolchain leverages CoreML and Apple Silicon. Builds are managed with Bazel or Swift Package Manager, with pre-built binaries available for both platforms.
title: Draw Things Community
